card.name: Partway through drug names
card.fires_on: Early pieces of a long drug name, often right after 'and' in a combination product, such as the 'b' in sulbactam or 'Nap' in naproxen. Also some other partway-through spots like eGFR and a book title.

modes.label: Second drug in a combination
modes.description: First piece of the second drug name after 'and'.

modes.label: Inside a long drug name
modes.description: A middle piece of a long generic drug name.

modes.label: Other partial words
modes.description: Start of a lab abbreviation or a word in a title.

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are word-start fragments, so it seems to discourage ending the name early; the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a long drug name, especially the second drug in a combination.
